about: Allowlist of the quality ratchet (tools/quality_ratchet.py). data_files: glob (repo-relative, forward slashes) -> reason; a matching file is not measured, so declare only data and generated files (the Suite's size_exempt list in tools/tests/suite_structure_allowlist.json counts as well). A baselined file that leaves measurement fails the check. allowed: one entry per file and metric that may exceed the baseline up to max, each with a reason and a date (YYYY-MM-DD); --update prunes entries the new baseline already covers.

allowed.reason: Suite.Client.LoadReasonText reads Blizzard's ADDON_<reason> text by the reason code C_AddOns.LoadAddOn returns, as Blizzard's AddOnUtil.lua does; one shared read replaces raw reason codes in three places.

CheckedCall is Safety.Call without the forbidden check per call, for the several getters TrackButton and AssetRole read from one object already checked once (CanTrack, AssetRole). It removed about 20% of the VM instructions of the first bag open (Perfy trace C, 2026-10-05).

The read-only preview reads external MSUF factories, the compact decoder and current frame settings at the host boundary. The shared current-settings getter replaces duplicate scale-readiness reads; missing exports, cache behavior and retained frames are covered by installer contracts. Edit-element suppression moved from optional MSUF_Suite_Modules/EditMode.lua into this shared host boundary: one additional external namespace read and two foreign-record checks, retaining the prior cold event-driven lifecycle. Independently reviewed against suite_runtime_owner_contract; no polling or new hot-path scan.
